title: Annotated Average
prompt: Implement average(values: list[float]) -> float that raises ValueError on an empty list. The annotations must be exactly list[float] and float (verifyable via typing.get_type_hints).

tests.name: computes the mean
tests.hint: sum/len — the annotations don't change behavior.

tests.name: empty input raises
tests.hint: Guard the empty case with ValueError.

tests.name: annotations are real
tests.code:
import typing
hints = typing.get_type_hints(average)
assert hints['values'] == list[float]
assert hints['return'] is float
tests.hint: Keep the annotations: get_type_hints must see list[float] and float.
